Executor catalog by domain

This catalog inventories the first-party executors in the source tree. A domain is derived from the canonical object in the executor name; it is not a manually maintained editorial classification.

This document is deterministically generated from 83 signed manifests under executors/. Executors installed from skills or synthesized locally belong to an instance's runtime catalog and are not published here.

An executor may implement a direct procedure or be a narrow-mandate intelligent executor; its public contract and domain placement do not change.
